stationaryAnalyticWallCheck.method: Unfolded alternating parallel planes: L_n=sqrt(D^2+(n*W)^2), pressure energy product^(1/2)/distance; no air/directivity factors in this reference.

limitations: Urban geometry and energy coefficients are authored assumptions unrelated to Legion Square
Finite specular wall paths through order10 do not implement diffuse late reverb or measured modal resonance
Residual Lectro/X80 pitch stepping remains open; this work changes no source pitch/texture controls
Offline timings retain every deadline miss and do not certify live performance
A fixed22m/s trajectory isolates city and exhaust comparisons; previous04 faster flybys are contextual references
Slight pitch stepping reported for Lectro and X80 Proto remains open. This environmental test does not resolve or validate that source issue.
Authored street geometry is unrelated to Legion Square; no measured outdoor RT60 or modal resonance is claimed.
Finite specular wall returns do not provide a complete diffuse urban reverberant field.
